description: Safe Git and GitHub delivery workflow for any repository. Use when the user asks to branch, commit, push, prepare/open a pull request, update an existing PR, or otherwise publish code changes. Preserves unrelated work, verifies the exact diff, keeps commits intentional, and never merges/releases/force-pushes unless explicitly authorized.
